prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Compact Layout Redesign: Redesigns the intro story screen into a compact layout with streamlined copy to help users understand the companion concept faster before choosing a path.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Meet Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Choose a companion that lives right on your desktop, ready to help, play, and keep you company as you work."}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Identity & Character Card Screen: Adds a new pet identity screen right before adoption certificate that highlights the pet's character stats and initial setup options.
   config: {"new_pet_identity": {"headline": "Meet Your New Companion", "body": "Here are your companion's initial traits and abilities.", "layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Companion Verified", "style": "highlight"}, {"type": "text", "text": "Your pet will react to desktop activity and quick commands.", "style": "plain"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_pet_identity", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
2: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Checklist Layout Redesign: Redesigns the engine initialization waiting screen into a checklist layout showing setup progress for graphics and desktop permissions.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home", "body": "Initializing companion graphics renderer and system integration.", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true}}
3: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Split Layout Redesign: Redesigns the final home intro screen into a split layout separating basic desktop controls from pet customization tips.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Your Companion is Ready on Desktop!", "body": "Use the tray icon to quickly access controls, change pet status, or customize interactions."}}
4: [sign_in, redesign] Sign-In Options List Layout Redesign: Rebuilds the sign-in screen into a clean vertical list layout with clear data safety assurances.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "list", "headline": "Sign In to Save Your Companion", "body": "Signing in links your pet adoption to your account so you never lose your companion.", "hint": "Your pet state and stats are automatically backed up."}}
5: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Verification Badge on Sign In: Adds an account backup verification badge component to the sign-in options section.
   config: {"sign_in": {"replace": {"sign_in_options": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Automatic Cloud Save Enabled", "style": "highlight", "role": "sign_in_options"}]}}}
6: [choose_path, incentive] Choose Path Value Incentive Highlight: Adds a companion perk callout component to the path selection options.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "All paths include lifetime cloud backup and free starter accessories."}}
7: [adoption, copy] Adoption Stamp Certification Audio Effect: Updates the adoption certificate screen headline and action label to emphasize completion.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Adoption Certificate Verified", "body": "Your official adoption document is ready. Click finish to summon your pet to your desktop.", "button_label": "Summon Companion Now"}}
8: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Render Progress Notification: Displays estimated render preparation time and tips for multi-monitor setups during desktop engine launch.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 5, "hint": "If your pet doesn't display immediately, check your system tray icon."}}
9: [finish, notification] Desktop Quick Commands Overview on Home Intro: Adds a quick checklist component on home intro covering basic pet interactions: right-click tray, summon, and hide.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Right-click tray icon to open menu | Double-click pet to play | Press Esc to hide pet", "style": "playful"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns the story screen while preserving its job of introducing the pet companion.
Adds a valid new pet identity screen inside onboarding without removing any required steps.
Redesigns the waiting screen layout while keeping its job of showing the pet being prepared.
Redesigns the home intro screen layout within onboarding limits.
Redesigns the sign-in screen layout while retaining the ability to sign in.
Replacing the sign-in options component with a static badge removes the sign-in functionality, losing the screen's job.
Onboarding copy cannot mention free extras or gifts like 'free starter accessories'.
Updates text on the adoption certificate while maintaining the official adoption document design and function.
Adds waiting screen progress and tip configuration without violating base rules.
Adds a helpful interaction checklist to the home intro overlay.
